items.title: Cohen-Macaulayness read off from the vanishing of Ext into the normalized dualizing complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes finite Cohen-Macaulay modules over a Noetherian local ring with normalized dualizing complex by the vanishing pattern of Ext into that complex, and shows that Ext in degree minus the depth is an anti-auto-equivalence of the category of Cohen-Macaulay modules of fixed depth (author lemma at source lines 3306-3320, label lemma-local-CM). The proof (source lines 3322-3348) uses the degree confinement of those Ext modules, proves the easy implications, derives the converse from the double dual identification combined with the bound of depth by the dimension of the support, and reuses that identification for the anti-auto-equivalence (proof lines 3342-3347). The double dual step and the depth bound are the substance. H3.
